cases.label: Fight / boxing guard
cases.prompt: A person stands in a boxing stance with both hands raised in guard, lightly shifting weight between the feet.

cases.label: Fight / right straight
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance throws a fast right straight punch forward, then retracts the hand back to guard.

cases.label: Fight / left jab + right cross
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance throws a left jab followed by a right cross forward, shifting weight into the punches and returning the hands to guard.

cases.label: Fight / left hook + right cross
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance throws a left hook followed by a right straight punch, rotating the torso and returning to guard.

cases.label: Fight / right uppercut
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance dips slightly and throws a right uppercut upward in front of the body, then returns to guard.

cases.label: Fight / slip + counter
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance slips the head to one side to evade an imaginary punch, then throws a right straight counter punch forward.

cases.label: Fight / block + counter
cases.prompt: A person in a boxing stance raises both forearms to block an imaginary strike, then throws a left straight punch forward and returns to guard.

cases.label: Fight / lateral footwork
cases.prompt: A person maintains a boxing guard while taking quick short lateral steps to the left and right, keeping the knees slightly bent.

cases.label: Fight / shadow boxing
cases.prompt: A person shadow boxes in place, throwing rhythmic alternating jabs and crosses while lightly shifting weight and keeping the hands near guard between punches.

cases.label: Fight / front kick
cases.prompt: A person in a fighting stance raises the right knee and performs a right front kick forward, retracts the leg and returns to guard.

cases.label: Fight / roundhouse kick
cases.prompt: A person in a fighting stance pivots on the left foot and swings a right roundhouse kick across in front, then lowers the leg into a balanced fighting stance.

cases.label: Fight / mimed grab + pull + turn
cases.prompt: A person steps forward, mimes grabbing an imaginary opponent's arm with both hands, then pulls the hands inward while turning the torso to one side.

scope: Single-actor shadow combat: no second body, physical opponent contact, collision solve or validated martial technique. Person-based prompts follow official Kimodo guidance; robot appearance comes from original body retargeting.
